svg.title: One mask preserves row alignment
svg.desc: An illustrative table applies one Boolean row mask to distance, velocity and uncertainty so rows 0 and 3 stay aligned, while contrasting separate per-column masks that both return length 3 and silently pair row 2's 2100 km/s velocity with row 1's 30 km/s error.

g.title: trap_result
g.text: Matching (3,) lengths — no error, silent mismatch!
